q: Which block do you wrap around your own content to detect a press?
why: Pressable wraps any content and reports the press stages. It has no look of its own. A View is only a box.

q: In React Native you can write words directly inside a View, like <View>Hello</View>.
why: No. A View is a layout box. All words and numbers must be inside a Text.

q: Which of these style lines follow the React Native rules? Pick all that fit.
why: Names are camelCase and numbers have no unit, so marginTop: 8 is right. Percent values stay as text. "8px" is a web habit.
In a style array the last item wins when both set the same name. Items that are false, null or undefined are skipped.

q: Put the steps in order for how React Native joins the style array [a, false, b], from the first step to the result.
items: Take the style a as the start
Put the style b over a, so b wins where both set a name
Use the joined style on the Text
why: The items are joined from the first to the last. false, null and undefined are skipped, and the last item wins when names clash.

q: A picture from a web address shows nothing. What two style names must you set on the Image? Write them with a space between.
why: React Native cannot know the size of a network image before it downloads it, so you must give the width and the height yourself.
